noSubscriptions.title: No subscription imported
noSubscriptions.description: There is nothing to display on the Proxies page. Go to Profiles to import and activate a subscription.

inactiveSubscription.title: No active subscription
inactiveSubscription.description: Subscriptions were found, but none is currently active. Go to Profiles and select one to activate.

coreUnavailable.title: Core temporarily unavailable
coreUnavailable.description: Proxy information could not be retrieved from the core. Try restarting the core. If the problem persists, open the logs folder and check the core logs.

noProxyInfo.title: No proxy information available
noProxyInfo.description: There are no proxy groups or nodes to display. Check that the active subscription contains valid proxy groups and nodes, or restart the core and review the logs.

chain.warning: A chain changes the connection path of its bound group. Diagnose connectivity and verify the exit after applying it.
chain.empty: Select an entry, then the exit (up to 8 nodes).
chain.instruction: Click nodes in order to add to proxy chain
chain.minimumNodes: Chain proxy requires at least 2 nodes
chain.minimumNodesHint: Chain proxy requires at least 2 nodes. Please add one more node.
chain.connectFailed: Failed to connect to proxy chain
chain.disconnectFailed: Failed to disconnect from proxy chain
chain.duplicateNode: Proxy node already exists in chain
chain.scope: Bound group: {{group}} · Live selection: {{selected}} · Core mode: {{mode}}
chain.ruleScopeHint: Only requests routed to this group use the chain. Other rules may select a different exit.
chain.nodeDelayHint: Historical node delay is not an end-to-end chain connectivity result.

diagnostics.title: Diagnose and share a private report
diagnostics.explanation: Tests contact example.com. Prefix checks cover the configured path up to each node. Direct SOCKS5 checks are separate. The client cannot inspect an upstream configured on the VPS or prove that browser traffic is captured. With TUN enabled, an ordinary TCP probe is not treated as verified direct access.
diagnostics.expectedExitHint: If supplied, ifconfig.me is queried to compare the exit. For a VPS with an upstream, enter the upstream exit IP. The full IP is excluded from reports.
diagnostics.requestHint: Local view only. These core records may predate the latest change; they do not prove a public exit IP. Export replaces names and targets with aliases.

codes.PEER_CLOSED: The connection closed early; this alone does not identify which peer closed it.
codes.AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Authentication was rejected. Check credentials locally.
codes.DNS_FAILED: Name resolution failed during this test.
codes.HTTP_TARGET_REJECTED: The target returned an unsuccessful HTTP response.
codes.CHAIN_NOT_ACTIVE_IN_CURRENT_SCOPE: Apply the chain to a group used by the current mode.
codes.EXPECTED_EXIT_MISMATCH: The observed public exit differs from the expected IP.
codes.EXIT_NOT_VERIFIED: No successful exit comparison was completed.
codes.DIRECT_ROUTE_NOT_VERIFIED_WITH_TUN: TUN is enabled or unknown; a direct route cannot be guaranteed, so the direct test was skipped.
codes.CHAIN_CORE_UNAVAILABLE: Live core state is unavailable; core-dependent tests were not completed.

warnings.invalidTestUrl: Test URL must start with http:// or https://
